sentences.text: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy is a 2011 Cold War espionage film directed by Tomas Alfredson .	Tomas Alfredson	Tomas Alfredson	Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy	Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy (miniseries)	Cold War	Cold War	espionage film	Spy film

The screenplay was written by Bridget O'Connor and Peter Straughan , based on John le Carré 's 1974 novel of the same name .	Bridget O'Connor	Bridget O'Connor	Peter Straughan	Peter Straughan	John le Carré	John le Carré	novel of the same name	Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy

The film , starring Gary Oldman as George Smiley , along with Colin Firth , Tom Hardy , John Hurt , Toby Jones , Mark Strong , Benedict Cumberbatch , and Ciarán Hinds , is set in London in the early 1970s and follows the hunt for a Soviet double agent at the top of the British secret service .	Gary Oldman	Gary Oldman	Colin Firth	Colin Firth	Tom Hardy	Tom Hardy	John Hurt	John Hurt	Toby Jones	Toby Jones	Mark Strong	Mark Strong	Benedict Cumberbatch	Benedict Cumberbatch	Ciarán Hinds	Ciarán Hinds	George Smiley	George Smiley	Soviet	Soviet Union	double agent	double agent
The film was produced through the British company Working Title Films and financed by France 's StudioCanal .	StudioCanal	StudioCanal	Working Title Films	Working Title Films
It premiered in competition at the 68th Venice International Film Festival .	68th Venice International Film Festival	68th Venice International Film Festival
It was a critical and commercial success , and was the highest-grossing film at the British box office for three consecutive weeks .
It won the BAFTA Award for Best British Film .	BAFTA Award for Best British Film	BAFTA Award for Best British Film

The film also received three Academy Awards nominations : Best Adapted Screenplay , Best Original Score , and for Oldman , Best Actor .
